messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — I hit a broken image and a bad anchor in /kb/runtime/batching.md on staging. link-checker threw a flag during today's sweep. Anyone own that doc?
link-checker-bot: auto-scan: /kb/runtime/batching.md -> 403 on https://assets.internal.redwood/images/kv_cache.png and redirect to /runbook#batching-tips (404 mismatch)
Maria Gomez: @Alex can you paste the exact failing URL so I can repro locally?
Alex Chen: Image URL: https://assets.internal.redwood/images/kv_cache.png returns 403 from staging. Also internal anchor #batching-tips resolves to /runbook which looks like a bad redirect.
Samir Patel: I authored batching.md originally. I can take a quick look later today. If it's just an asset path, rehosting to the CDN is quick.
Jin Park: If rehosting, prefer s3://kb-static-prod and reference /cdn/kb/kv_cache.png. Quick patch idea: 
```
git checkout -b docs/rehost-kvcache
rg "kv_cache.png" -n | xargs -I{} sed -i 's|/images/kv_cache.png|/cdn/kb/kv_cache.png|g' {}
git commit -am "docs: rehost kv_cache.png to CDN and fix anchors"
```
Nora (docs-bot): Suggested label: docs/ownership-needed. Reminder: any CODEOWNERS changes should be covered by a small owners PR.
Alex Chen: This is blocking a customer demo tomorrow AM. Samir, can you pick it up? If not, anyone else? Small PR should be fine.
Samir Patel: I'll take it. @Alex if you open the PR I can review and add an OWNER change.
Alex Chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999 — tiny sed to update paths + fix the anchor target to /kb/runtime/batching.md#tips-for-batching. Assigning to @Samir.
Maria Gomez: Should we add a temporary 301 from /images/* -> /cdn/kb/* to reduce blast radius while assets repoint?
Jin Park: +1. nginx snippet for static-config: 
```
location ~ ^/images/(.*)$ {
  return 301 /cdn/kb/$1;
}
```
Samir Patel: Looks good. I'll add a revert window note (7 days) in the PR and update CODEOWNERS to include `@samir` for /kb/runtime/*.
Alex Chen: Thanks — assigning. @link-checker-bot can you re-run after merge and post results here?
link-checker-bot: Re-scan queued; will post results to #docs after PR merges. :robot_face:
Maria Gomez: :thumbsup: Great catch.
Alex Chen: I'll confirm the demo status post-merge.
